description: This Java class 'MongoMetricsBuilder' implements the 'MetricsBuilder' interface to provide custom metrics using 'DittoMetrics' for timers and histograms within a MongoDB context, specifically integrating with Akka persistence. It defines methods to create timers and histograms, and tracks the maximum timer value in nanoseconds.

classes.name: MongoMetricsBuilder
classes.description: A metrics builder for MongoDB that integrates with DittoMetrics to provide timers and histograms, optimized for use with Akka persistence in a MongoDB context.

methods.name: timer
methods.description: Creates a MongoTimer that uses DittoMetrics to measure elapsed time, recording the maximum duration in nanoseconds.

methods.name: histogram
methods.description: Creates a MongoHistogram that records a value into a DittoMetrics histogram.

methods.name: maxTimerNanos
methods.description: Provides access to the LongAccumulator tracking the maximum timer duration in nanoseconds.
